verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS accounting product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers MCP, API, exports, AI features and UI settings such as dark mode, but nothing about telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking controls. That leaves no product capability to credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
